description: Fifty hangers, each 17 inches wide and 8.3 inches tall, wrapped in a velvet flocking that does the one thing a hanger is actually hired to do. Silk blouses, jersey dresses, anything with a slippery shoulder seam stays put on the rail instead of ending up in a heap on the closet floor. Below the shoulders runs a horizontal pants bar, which sounds like a small thing until you realize a full suit now hangs as one unit on one hook. Jacket up top, trousers folded over the bar. The same trick works for a skirt and the top that goes with it. Each hanger is built from ABS plastic around a metal hook and is rated to 11 pounds, or 5 kilograms. That number is worth paying attention to if you own a wool overcoat or a heavy leather jacket, because plenty of velvet hangers flex or give out under real winter weight.
